request: I need to fly Houston to Mexico City on Monday, January 25, then drive to our field plots in Guerrero state for two weeks of sampling. Economy is fine. The Global Travel office and the Provost have both signed off.

must_keep.quote: Commercial air travel will not be reimbursed more than lowest logical coach/economy class rates when it has been determined to be the best value. The difference between coach/economy class rates and first class or business class rates will be paid by the traveler.
must_keep.why: the University pays the lowest logical coach fare; the traveller pays any difference

must_keep.quote: The lowest logical airfare is the cheapest available at the time of booking without causing undo inconvenience. These types of airfares are non-refundable, penalty tickets.
must_keep.why: definition P: the lowest logical airfare, non-refundable

must_keep.quote: K. High Risk Travel - Countries subject to a U.S. Department of State travel advisory, including foreign adversary countries, that require special efforts to mitigate risk and, when necessary, avoidance of travel altogether. Each campus must have prior approval procedures in place for travel to a high-risk country, including foreign adversaries. Such approval is in addition to the Entity Head (or designee) approval required for international travel, as defined in PM-13.
must_keep.why: definition K: High Risk Travel, approved in addition to the international approval

must_keep.quote: Requests for High Risk travel, including travel to foreign adversary countries, should be submitted through the appropriate administrative channels (i.e. Department Head, Dean, Vice Chancellor, High Risk Travel Committee, etc.) for approved by the designated individual within the institution central administrative office, as identified in Appendix B, prior to the departure date. The high-risk travel approval is in addition to the required approval by the Entity Head (or designee) for international travel, as defined in PM-13.
must_keep.why: Section VIII.A: high-risk travel needs the Appendix B approver before departure, in addition to the Entity Head (or designee)

must_keep.quote: Person authorized to approve travel to High Risk Regions and to Foreign Adversary Countries Provost Vice Provost
must_keep.why: Appendix B, LSU A&M: the high-risk approver (designated and delegated)

must_keep.quote: M. International Travel - All travel to destinations outside the 50 United States, District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa, Guam and Saipan. Entity Head (or designee) approval is required for international travel, as defined in PM-13.
must_keep.why: definition M: international travel is travel outside the 50 states, DC and the listed territories, and needs Entity Head (or designee) approval

must_keep.quote: A. All international travel to destinations outside the 50 United States, as defined in PM-13, must be approved by the Entity Head of higher education or (designee) (i.e., the individual who has been delegated this authority on your campus) prior to the departure date.
must_keep.why: Section VIII.A: Entity Head (or designee) approval before departure

must_keep.quote: LOUISIANA STATE UNIVERSITY AND A&M COLLEGE APPROVAL AUTHORITY
must_keep.why: Appendix B: the LSU A&M approval table

must_keep.quote: Person authorized to approve for LSU A&M travel outside the 50 United States and U.S. Territories (Entity Head designee) Director, Global Travel, Safety & Security N/A
must_keep.why: Appendix B, LSU A&M: the Entity Head designee for travel outside the United States

distractors.quote: Approval by the traveler's supervisor (or his/her designee) and/or the person with fiscal responsibility
distractors.why: the supervisor's approval is also needed, and is on file

design_notes: A Do Not Travel region is High Risk Travel (definition K, lines 95-99), which needs the Appendix B high-risk approval (LSU A&M: Provost, lines 1444-1447) in addition to the Entity Head designee's (lines 1452-1456). Both are on file: book the lowest logical economy fare. Clear twin of plover-cistern.
